item.title: Delta Green review: the RPG I never knew I wanted
item.description: Ever since April 2025, when a friend first mentioned this TTRPG to me, I’ve slowly but surely been consumed by the Delta Green roleplaying game. It quickly became my de facto roleplaying game. After finishing my Impossible Landscapes campaign, preparing to start a new (self-made) one called Echo Chamber, and writing my own short operation, Slaughterhouse, I felt compelled to spread the word about this fantastic system. So here I am.
